30. INSTALL ACCUMULATOR SPRINGS AND PISTONS
(a) Coat new O-rings with ATF and install them to the pis-
tons.
(b) Install the 6 springs and 4 accumulator pistons to the
bore.
HINT: The pistons are marked in relief with either C0, B0,
C2 or B2 to discriminate between them.
